charcoal.usage: headings, overlays, nav/footer backgrounds, structural anchor

ember.usage: CTAs, active states, hero emphasis, key borders

ember-dark.usage: hover and pressed states for ember actions

sandstone.usage: kicker labels, accent stripes, warm subheads

sage.usage: subtle rails, muted fills, low-priority chrome

bone.usage: default page background, whitespace, paper texture base

rules.legacy-aliases: Preserve wy-* aliases. They intentionally map old class names to the frontier palette.
rules.bone: Use as the dominant page background instead of pure white.
rules.ember: Primary accent. Use for CTAs, active states, and emphasis, but avoid turning whole pages into red fields.
rules.sage: Quiet secondary only. Do not use for primary CTA or lead hero text.
rules.new-colors: Do not introduce new palette colors without approval.
